title: All or Nothing with Collect
goal: Turn a collection of string inputs into a single Result of numbers using iterators.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Option and Result

hints: FromIterator is implemented for Result<Vec<T>, E> directly.
Do not extract values inside the map closure. Let collect handle early return when an error occurs.
explanation: `s.parse::<i32>()` returns `Result<i32, ParseIntError>`. Standard library `FromIterator` allows collecting `Iterator<Item = Result<T, E>>` into `Result<Vec<T>, E>`. If any item is `Err`, iteration halts and returns that error. Choice `s.parse::<i32>().unwrap()` panics on invalid text instead of returning a `Result`. Choice `.collect::<Vec<_>>()` produces `Vec<Result<i32, ParseIntError>>`, which violates the return type signature (`E0308`).
